name: Implement and Verify
description: Engineer-side process for the improvement loop. Implements changes within scope globs, runs pre-commit gates, provisions a test agent for live verification, exercises canned test missions, opens a PR, and tears down the test agent. Designed to be invoked via delegation from a product-architect agent.

scope_globs.description: File patterns the implementation may touch (e.g., 'corekit/lib/scheduler.mjs')

acceptance_criteria.description: Testable criteria from the architect's proposal

proposal_link.description: Drive link to the architect's proposal document

branch_slug.description: Short slug for the branch name (e.g., 'dedup-scheduler')

steps.title: Set up workspace and implement changes
steps.accept_criteria: Changes implemented within scope globs. Feature branch created. All changes committed with clear messages. No files outside scope were modified.

steps.title: Run pre-commit validation
steps.description:
Run all applicable pre-commit checks on the implementation: JSON validity for any changed .json files, contract validation if contracts were modified, the full test suite, manifest integrity if manifests were changed. Verify that only in-scope files were modified and no debug artifacts (stray logging, debugger statements, unresolved TODOs) were introduced.

If any check fails, fix the issue and re-run. Do not proceed with failures.

Output: gate results (pass/fail for each check), test output summary.
steps.accept_criteria: All pre-commit gates pass: tests pass, no out-of-scope changes, no debug artifacts. Gate results documented.

steps.title: Provision and verify test agent
steps.description:
Push the feature branch to remote. Provision a temporary test agent with the engineer specialty running the feature branch code. Wait for the agent to come online, then verify it is healthy. Retry verification up to 5 times with reasonable intervals.

If provisioning fails, check prerequisites and retry once. If health checks fail after all retries, report blocked.

Output: test agent name, online status, verification results.
steps.accept_criteria: Test agent provisioned and online. Health checks pass. Agent is running the feature branch code.

steps.title: Exercise test agent with canned missions
steps.description:
Send three canned test missions to the test agent to validate end-to-end behavior:

**Mission 1 — Simple Q&A:** Send a direct question and verify a timely response. Confirm a mission was created and completed.

**Mission 2 — Process execution:** Ask the test agent to execute a process. Verify it loads and completes at least the first checkpoint.

**Mission 3 — Memory round-trip:** Ask the test agent to write a test fact to Core Memory and read it back. Verify the write and retrieval succeeded.

For each mission, check completion logs and error logs. If a mission fails, fix the code, push the fix, re-deploy to the test agent, and retry (max 3 iterations). If still failing, report blocked with evidence.

Output: mission results (pass/fail for each), evidence from logs.
steps.accept_criteria: All 3 canned missions completed successfully. Evidence collected from logs. Any failures were fixed and re-verified.

steps.title: Open PR and teardown test agent
steps.description:
Open a pull request with the feature branch targeting main. Include the scope block, test-agent evidence (mission IDs), and a QA summary in the PR body. Confirm CI passes.

Tear down the test agent — never leave a branch-ref agent running. If teardown fails, retry and escalate to force-removal.

Send the delegation result back to the architect agent with: PR URL, test evidence, QA summary, and final status.

Output: PR URL, CI status, teardown confirmation, delegation result sent.
steps.accept_criteria: PR opened with scope block and test evidence. CI green. Test agent torn down. Delegation result sent to the architect agent.
